rows.topic: Casino discovery versus real-money gambling facilitation
rows.confidence: High for inspected source; medium for total release
rows.requirement_type: Policy or explicitly conditional guidance
rows.requirement: Assess casino discovery versus real-money gambling facilitation under the named provisions.

official_provisions.section: Gambling Apps; Other Real-Money Games, Contests, and Tournament Apps; Examples of violations

rows.finding: The picker randomly selects a physical venue. No stake, deposit, cash prize, gambling account, odds or gambling payment control was identified in reviewed implementation/source. Casino result UI offers mapping, rideshare and optional telephone; the venue website CTA is date-night-only. Catalog website fields do not establish an exposed wagering link.
rows.qualification: This is a source-backed distinction, not Google's approval or a legal determination. Dice/chip artwork and the word roulette alone do not prove simulated gambling or wagering. Dynamic provider output, final native interaction and any later monetization remain outside this clearance.
rows.next_action: Preserve the discovery-only boundary; describe physical venue discovery accurately to reviewers. Escalate any later betting, signup, deposit, prize or gambling affiliate functionality for a new policy review.
rows.acceptance: On the exact release, inspect Casino selection, options and result, including favorites/history and native external navigation. Verify no wagering/account/deposit/odds/prize CTA or hidden gambling WebView; assert the Nightlife result cannot render the date-night website CTA.

rows.qualification: A source filename, owner approval, generation-style label, public availability or unchanged hash does not itself establish usage rights. This is an evidence HOLD, not a finding of infringement. Video/audio contents and all other artwork were not exhaustively inspected. Original assets may be supported by owner/creator provenance and applicable generation-tool terms. This does not demand paid legal clearance or written permission for every factual brand reference.
rows.next_action: Assemble an asset ledger with creator/source, acquisition or generation context, applicable license/terms/permission, modification rights and attribution requirements. Resolve unknowns before certifying rights; preserve the approved artwork rather than redesigning it automatically.
rows.acceptance: Every shipped and proposed listing asset maps to documented rights and required notices. Independently review the startup video/audio and unsampled art; verify the exact licensed versions and derivative permissions.
